target_customer: Freight teams, manufacturers, retailers and 3PLs that need to know which shipments are exposed to wars, strikes and tariffs
problem: Geopolitical shocks break global shipping with little warning, and logistics teams react after the disruption. Ekho forecasts escalation and recommends reroutes, carriers and booking windows.
business_model: B2B SaaS and managed service sold to logistics and supply chain teams (pricing not public)
product_category: Supply chain risk intelligence and geopolitical forecasting

founders.name: Alina Park
previous_startups: Yachay AI (text-based geolocation project, outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists CFTC Innovator of the Year and guest talks at Columbia MBA and Stanford Engineering. Education not listed on the YC page. The YC page names only one founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting geopolitical escalation and mapping it to purchase order level exposure needs multi-source signal ingestion and modeling, plus TMS and ERP connectors. A small team can build a first version, but accuracy is hard to prove.

defensibility.rationale: The site publishes forecasts and reviews its own predictions, which builds a track record, but no proprietary data or lock-in is evidenced. Incumbent risk platforms can add similar signals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say. Established supply chain risk vendors existed at founding (named from general category knowledge, not confirmed by a dated source in this research).

market_need_then: The company cites the 2026 Iran war and a March 2026 Strait of Hormuz shipping brief as demand drivers. Tariff and conflict disruption to shipping is a widely reported pain, but no customer spend is documented in sources found.

branding.domain_note: Uses ekholabs.com; an unrelated vehicle commerce company named Ekho (ekho.com) exists

identity.voice_and_tone: Analytical forecasting voice; publishes market briefs and self-reviews its predictions

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage of the brand found; aggregators confuse it with the unrelated Ekho vehicle commerce company.

outcome_analysis: The company is active in the Summer 2026 batch and has no outcome yet. Its founder has a prior engineering background in compliance analytics and a geolocation research project. No funding, customers or launch press were found beyond the company's own pages, so the early signal is limited to the YC admission and the published forecasts.
notes: A Dealroom listing shows a $125k seed with no investor named; seen only on one aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. The $17.3M raise by Ekho (vehicle commerce, YC S22) is a different company. The company site describes managed inventory planning while the YC page describes freight geopolitical forecasting, so product scope is unclear. No competitor dated near the batch was confirmed, so the list is empty. A wiki source gives an August 2026 public launch date; unverified. Completeness pass: Recorded the Dealroom $125k seed (no date or investor shown); single database, no press found in a cross-check search. The recorded round rests on a single database or outlet and was not cross-checked by press.
